entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever! I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse. I bought it a couple of weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago. What is the reason for the return?
It's just not accurate! The heart rate monitor is all over the place, and the sleep tracking is completely useless. I expected more from this smart watch. I want my money back.

I apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with the VeloBand Pulse. At VeloFit, we stand by our products. Let me check our return policy. We have a standard return policy of 90 days. Since you are within that time frame, I am happy to process a return for you.
90 days? Seriously? I was worried I was outside the window. Okay, great! What do I need to do?

I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Simply repackage the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive the returned item, we will process your refund, which should appear in your account within 7-10 business days.
Perfect! That sounds easy enough. I just need to get this VeloBand Pulse back to you guys. When will I receive the email?
You should receive the email with the shipping label within the next hour. Please let us know if you don't receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it! Thank you so much for your help. I was really dreading this, but you made it so easy. I was afraid of some complicated return policy.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful day!
